english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a pantyliner, rather than the broader sanitary-product terms.

examples.english: I usually wear a liner, so I do not have to worry about staining my underwear.
examples.traditional: 我通常會用護墊，咁就唔使成日擔心整污糟條底褲。
